pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql (NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, CHECK); test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks all seeded rows are 0 and done=2 is rejected.
src/index.js default view open; 'AC-2' test checks / and ?view=open list only open items in id order.
'AC-3' test marks 3,1 done and expects ['✓ First item','✓ Third item'] in id order.
'AC-4' test expects all three items in order with ✓ only on done.
'AC-5' test asserts exact nav HTML for each view and for /; current is <strong>, not a link.
'AC-6' test checks 400 and no <li> for Open, closed, empty, __proto__ (Object.hasOwn guard).
'AC-7' test covers Nothing open., Nothing done yet., and No items yet. on all three views with an empty table.
traffic/routes.json contains both routes; 'AC-8' test asserts they are in routes.json.

findings.what: Commit 48d0a50 ('Follow-up edits') loosened the synthetic-traffic assertion from toEqual(['/healthz', ...ROUTES]) to expect(...).toBeDefined(), which can never fail. The test no longer checks that the traffic worker requests /healthz and every route, including the new ?view routes. The spec doesn't justify this.
The PR says 'Tests deleted or loosened: none' and describes only the fake app change. The last commit loosened an assertion to toBeDefined(), so the claim is false.
findings.fix: Restore the assertion and keep the claim, or disclose the loosening and the reason.

findings.what: README says the traffic worker hits `/healthz` plus the paths in routes.json, and doesn't mention that routes may now carry a query string.
findings.fix: Add a note that routes may include a query string.

lenses.note: The change follows the spec's decisions: it opens on open items and uses the view query parameter. Nothing extra beyond the traffic-check regex change, which AC-8 needs.
All 8 ACs and all 6 state rows have tests. The spec was not edited after the go.
The done tests are solid, but the follow-up commit loosened a traffic test to toBeDefined(). I did not run the tests; the repo has no CI workflow I checked.
README updated for the views. It doesn't mention query-string routes.
The view lookup uses Object.hasOwn, and the SQL fragments come from a fixed map, so there is no injection. Empty-table handling is correct.
The view value is validated against a whitelist, titles are escaped, and the regex change still refuses spaces and #.
The diff changes the HTML the page renders (nav and ✓ marks), but I found no style or template files in it.
The page's behaviour is covered by tests; there is no browser evidence.
The 'loosened: none' claim is false because of the last commit.
